rows.title: The live animals list is reframed in place, scoped to the trader's organisation, and plants' list takes the same frame
rows.detail: The live animals notification list stays at the live-animals set root in the animals frontend and is reframed there: a 'Dashboard' browser title and caption, the category as the heading, a primary 'Create new' button straight under the heading, the cards under 'Notifications' and each card named for assistive technology. The list shows every notification of the signed-in trader's organisation, so a trader who signs in afresh still sees their earlier notifications. Plants' own list takes the same frame in the same increment and keeps its own first question. Every new string has a Welsh version.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in trader opening the live animals list sees the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Live animals'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-024; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-023; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-003, repo-frontend-p4-004; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-086)

A signed-in trader opening plants' notification list sees the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Plants'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-003, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-004; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

On the live animals list and on plants' list the element straight after the h1 is a primary 'Create new' button, and the element straight after the button is the 'Notifications' section. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-023; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-005; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-005, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-006; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

Pressing 'Create new' on the live animals list, with or without JavaScript, starts a live animals notification with the status Draft in the live-animals set and lands on that set's first journey page; opening or reloading the list starts no notification. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-024; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-007, repo-frontend-p4-008, repo-frontend-p4-082; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087)

Pressing 'Create new' on plants' list starts a high-risk plants notification and lands on the commodity type page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-007, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-045, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-075; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-020, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087)

On the live animals list and on plants' list the notification cards sit under the h2 'Notifications'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-026; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-028; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-012; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-008, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-072; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-088)

Each card on the live animals list and on plants' list has the accessible name 'Notification <reference>' and the reference as its h3. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-046; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-037, repo-frontend-p4-038; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-020)

A trader who signs in afresh sees on the live animals list every notification their organisation has, including ones started in an earlier session, and none of another organisation's. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-069; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-091; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-095; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010)

With Welsh chosen, every string on the live animals list and on plants' list shows in Welsh, and no label is blank in either language. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-083, repo-frontend-p4-084; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-063, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-066)

rows.gate: Look at the reframed frame on both lists (title, caption, heading, 'Create new', 'Notifications', card names) and the organisation-scoped list before the card, tab, search, filter, paging and germinal list rows copy them.
openQuestions: What plants' list heading says, when the frame names the category and the design has no plants list (c-303). Default, which the builder follows and says so: 'Plants', with a Welsh machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off.
rows.notes: Combines the frame slices of both lists (title and caption, heading, 'Create new', 'Notifications', card names, Welsh) with the organisation scope, because they change the same template, controller and copy of each list's dashboard feature. 'Create new' keeps today's form post: the set the button belongs to carries the category, and where it points is the frontend's to name (c-251); the category stored on the record is the category-on-create row. Each Welsh string is a machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off under the Welsh Language Standards; record it as such in the copy. The animals backend already refuses a list call with no organisation header (its trader organisation header filter), so the scope change is the frontend's list read, which today narrows to the session's own journeys; plants' list stays session-scoped (c-300). The k6 journey's list reads (req-1852) live in perftests src/k6/journeys.js, which theme manage-notifications owns, so that requirement is split off to it. The delete and cancel-amendment breadcrumbs keep the shared 'Your notifications' label: only the list's own h2 changes. Under c-496's default the germinal products list copy takes the same frame in the same increment once it exists (see the germinal list row).

rows.title: Notification cards show the design's facts and status styles, on the live animals list and on plants' list
rows.detail: Each card is relaid to the design: the live animals card shows commodity, arrival date, consignee and status, then the number of animals, origin and consignor; plants' card takes the same layout with its own facts. The arrival date is written in full, a fact not yet answered reads 'Not applicable', and the status tags take the design's styles. The animals backend's list returns every fact the cards show, the number of animals and the category among them, and plants' posting actions move into the card's own action list.
acceptanceCriteria: Each live animals card shows exactly seven facts in two rows: 'Commodity', 'Arrival date', 'Consignee' and 'Notification status', then 'Number of animals', 'Origin' and 'Consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-053, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-132; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-046; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-039; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-020)

A live animals card's 'Number of animals' shows the count of animals the notification records. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-046; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-037; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090)

Each plants card shows exactly five facts: 'Commodity', 'Arrival date' and 'Notification status' in the first row, with a red 'Late' tag beside the status when the notification is late, then 'Origin' and 'Consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-053, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-132; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-021, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-026, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-027, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-087; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-098)

On the live animals list and on plants' list a card writes the arrival date as the day, the full month name and the year, such as '21 June 2026'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-047; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-043; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-058; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-073)

On the live animals list and on plants' list a card whose notification has no commodity, no arrival date or (on the live animals card) no number of animals yet shows 'Not applicable' for that fact. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-055, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-056; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-045; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-061)

A live animals card's 'Commodity' is the commodity's name, such as 'Cow' for a commodity chosen as Bos taurus. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-056; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-041, repo-frontend-p4-047; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-024)

A draft's status is a 'Draft' tag in a colour other than the blue of the 'Submitted' tag, a submitted notification's status is the default blue 'Submitted' tag, and a notification being amended shows a yellow 'Amend' tag, on the live animals card and on plants' card. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-062, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-121; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-050, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-054; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-025; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090)

On plants' list each posting action sits in the card's own action list beside its title, beside the card's link actions. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-126; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-062; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-023, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-024; ruling:sam-2026-11-19 ruling-sam-2026-11-19-p1-006)

The animals backend's list returns for each notification its reference number, status, commodity name, arrival date, origin, consignee name, consignor name and category, with its number of animals or, for a germinal products notification, its number of packages and each line's species and product type; a fact the notification does not hold comes back empty. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-039, repo-frontend-p4-046, repo-frontend-p4-087; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)

rows.notes: Combines the card-facts slices of both lists, the full-month arrival date, 'Not applicable', the status tag styles and the backend facts behind the cards, because they change the same card view model and template and the one list projection. Takes in the card status styles (inc-131, now merged here: same view model, no question of its own). The card's 'Arrival date' label is settled by the 27 November ruling (c-421); the question page and check your answers keep 'Arrival date at port of entry'. Submitted is blue on plants too (c-301); a notification submitted with items outstanding is 'Submitted' like any other (c-418). The card tags take their own styles in the dashboard feature: the journey strip's status map in each frontend's shared kit is theme journey-foundation's, and stays as it is. The backend list projection (NotificationView) sits in theme overview-and-review's files, and the list endpoint in manage-notifications'; this theme lands after both. Under c-496's default the germinal products list copy takes the same card change in the same increment once it exists.

rows.title: The live animals list has 'Submitted', 'Draft and Amend' and 'Past' tabs
rows.detail: The live animals list groups its notifications into three tabs built as sub navigation links, each counted where the design counts it and each with its own subheading and description. The animals backend's list filters by category and tab and reports the counts the tabs show.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows the tabs 'Submitted', 'Draft and Amend' and 'Past' as sub navigation links, each loading the list with that tab chosen; with no tab chosen, or an unknown one, 'Submitted' is chosen, and following a tab clears the search, sort and filters. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-117; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

The 'Submitted' tab lists submitted notifications, the 'Draft and Amend' tab lists drafts and notifications being amended, and the 'Past' tab lists completed notifications. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-118, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-120)

A notification being amended is listed in the 'Draft and Amend' tab with a yellow 'Amend' tag and the actions Resume, 'Copy as new', 'Cancel amendment' and Delete. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-124)

The 'Submitted' and 'Draft and Amend' tabs show their counts in bold brackets, such as 'Submitted (2)' and 'Draft and Amend (3)'; 'Past' shows no count, even when chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-117)

Under the tabs the cards sit under an h3 naming the tab, 'Submitted notifications', 'Draft notifications' or 'Past notifications', followed by its description: 'Notifications you have submitted. You can still change them and add documents.', 'Notifications you have started but not submitted, and notifications that are being amended.' or 'Notifications that have been processed. They move here 2 weeks after the commodity arrival date.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-119)

The animals backend's list filters by category (live animals or germinal products, a record with no category counting as live animals) and by tab, and reports how many notifications the 'Submitted' and 'Draft and Amend' tabs each hold. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)
openQuestions: Which words and grouping the tabs use (c-497). Default, which the builder follows and says so: 'Submitted', 'Draft and Amend' (drafts and notifications being amended) and 'Past', counts on the first two, the subheadings and descriptions above, and the tabs built as sub navigation links.

What puts a notification in the 'Past' tab (c-498). Default, which the builder follows and says so: completed notifications only, so the tab stays empty until a real source of completion exists; the description is shown as the design words it.
rows.notes: Every requirement here is a question with a default, so it is not on the area's to-build list; it is drafted so the tabs keep their row. Stands apart from the search and filter rows because it carries c-497 and c-498, which they rest on. The tab parameter's name and values are the animals frontend's to name (c-251). Under c-496's default the germinal products list copy takes the tabs in the same increment once it exists.

rows.title: The live animals list's search and sort become one form that really searches and sorts
rows.detail: The search and the sort move into one column above the cards and become one form to the list's own address. The search finds notifications by reference, commodity, consignee or consignor, and the list is always sorted by one of three orders. The animals backend's list takes the search text and the new sorts, and breaks ties so paging never repeats or skips a notification. Plants' list takes the one-column layout now; its own search and sort wait for the plants backend.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals list, inside the 'Notifications' section, the search, then the sort, then 'Additional filters', then the tabs sit in one column above the cards; on plants' list the search and the sort sit in one column above the cards. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-026; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-028; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-013; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-009, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-092, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

The live animals list's search field is labelled 'Search by' with the hint 'Keyword, notification number, commodity, consignee or consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-030; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-028; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-005)

The search is submitted by a submit button that shows only a magnifying-glass icon and has the accessible name 'Search'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-006; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-097)

Searching the live animals list for part of a notification's reference number, commodity name, consignee name or consignor name, in any case, lists every notification of the trader's organisation that contains it, and a complete reference lists that notification. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-019, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-022; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-085, repo-tests-p3-089; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010)

The animals backend's list takes a search text and returns, paged, every notification of the caller's organisation whose reference number, commodity, consignee or consignor contains it, ignoring case and surrounding spaces. (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-016, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-017, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-021; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-024)

The live animals list's sort select is labelled 'Sort by:' and offers exactly 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', in that order. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-028; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-043, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-046; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-022)

'Newest first' and 'Oldest first' order the cards by when each notification was created, 'Arrival date' orders them by arrival date newest first, and with no sort chosen the cards are in arrival date order newest first with 'Arrival date' selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-028; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-047, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-047; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-031; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-098)

The search and the sort are one GET form to the list's own address: the search button submits both, with the chosen tab when it is not the default and the current page when it is above 1, so the result stays on that tab; changing the sort select submits nothing by itself, and the chosen sort stays selected after the page reloads. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-026, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-107; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-053; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-030, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-033, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-034, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-036)

The animals backend's list sorts by creation date newest first or oldest first and by arrival date, defaults to arrival date newest first, and orders notifications with the same date by a second key, so walking every page lists each notification exactly once. (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-092; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-057; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-031, repo-frontend-p4-033; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-091)

rows.notes: Combines the layout, search, sort and one-form slices with the backend's search and sort, because they share the one form, the list read and the backend query. The search, sort and filters apply for real on the server (c-162); the list is always sorted, with no unselected option (c-161); the toolbox components are the GOV.UK and MoJ ones, with no custom JavaScript (c-299). 'Apply filters' joins the form in the filters row. The k6 journey (theme manage-notifications' src/k6/journeys.js) searches the list with ?referenceNumber=<id> and checks the reference is on the page: keep that query answering, or tell that branch the new parameter in the handover. The list endpoint and its query sit in manage-notifications' and overview-and-review's files; this theme lands after both. Plants' own search, sort and 'Update sort' stay until the plants backend can query them (the blocked plants row). Depends on the tabs row because the form carries the chosen tab.

rows.title: The live animals list has 'Additional filters' for arrival date, date range and status
rows.detail: Inside the one search form, an 'Additional filters' disclosure offers an arrival-date choice, a date range with date pickers and a status select, applied with an 'Apply filters' button. A date that cannot be read is shown back as an error. A status filter shows every matching notification across the tabs, with a count, and a link clears the filters. The animals backend's list filters by status and arrival-date range.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list's search form holds an 'Additional filters' details disclosure, closed on load and open whenever an arrival-date, date-range or status filter is set. (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-008, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-013; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-108; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-033, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-066; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

The filters have a 'By arrival date' column of small radios 'Today', 'Tomorrow' and 'Next 7 days', whose visually hidden legend repeats the column's heading; choosing one and applying the filters lists only notifications arriving in that range, and the choice stays checked. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-031; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-041; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-034; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-001, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-003)

The filters have a 'By date range' column with the hint 'For example, 27/3/2026' and two date pickers, 'Start date' and 'End date', each with a 'Choose date' calendar that opens on the current month with weeks starting on Monday, and each a plain text field without JavaScript. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-031, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-032; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-042; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-035, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-036; ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-040; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-037, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-038)

Applying a start and an end date lists only notifications arriving between them, and the entered dates stay in the pickers. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-032; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-005, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-006; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-039)

A start or end date that cannot be read as a date, or an end date before the start date, shows an error summary and an inline error on that date field reading 'Enter a real start date', 'Enter a real end date' or 'End date must be the same as or after the start date'; 'Additional filters' is open, the pickers keep the entered text, and the list shows the notifications matching every other filter. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-002, ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-003, ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-019; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010)

The filters have a 'Status' select offering 'All statuses' (selected by default), 'Draft', 'Amend', 'Submitted' and 'Past'; choosing one and applying the filters lists only drafts not being amended, notifications being amended, submitted notifications or completed notifications, and the choice stays selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-110; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

The filters end with an 'Apply filters' submit button, which submits the one search form with the search, the sort and every filter. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-107; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-045; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-039; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-035)

With a status filter set, the list shows no tabs and lists every notification matching the filters, from every tab, under the h3 'Filtered results' with no description beneath it. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-109; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-056; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-061)

With a status filter set and the search field empty, the filtered results show a status line announced to assistive technology, giving the number of matches across every page: 'No notifications match your filters.', '1 notification matches your filters.' or '<n> notifications match your filters.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-112, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-113; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-062, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-063)

The filtered results have a 'Clear filters' link that opens the list keeping only the tab and the sort, and the tabs show again. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-114; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-059; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-067)

openQuestions: Which words the status select uses and what 'Past' holds (c-497, c-498). Default, which the builder follows and says so: 'All statuses', 'Draft', 'Amend', 'Submitted' and 'Past', with 'Past' holding completed notifications only, so choosing it lists none until a real source of completion exists.
rows.notes: Combines the disclosure, the arrival-date and date-range filters, their validation, the status select, 'Apply filters', the filtered results with their count and 'Clear filters', and the backend filters, because they share the one form, the list read and the backend query. Date validation is a real constraint the prototype lacks (c-166); the date pickers are the MoJ date picker the interaction designer keeps (c-299). A notification submitted with items outstanding is 'Submitted', and the list has no needs-action filter (c-418). The list endpoint and its query sit in manage-notifications' and overview-and-review's files; this theme lands after both. Under c-496's default the germinal products list copy takes the filters in the same increment once it exists.

rows.title: The lists page 8 at a time with numbered pages, and show the cards with no results count or empty-list message
rows.detail: The live animals list shows 8 notifications a page, and both lists page with numbered links. Page links keep the tab, sort, search and filters. Neither list shows a results count or an empty-list sentence: the cards follow the controls. The animals backend serves 8 a page.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows 8 notifications a page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; ruling:ian-2026-11-23 ruling-ian-2026-11-23-p1-008, ruling-ian-2026-11-23-p1-010; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-092; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-081)

The animals backend's list serves 8 notifications a page, numbered from 1, and reports the page, the size, the number of elements, the total elements and the total pages. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-081; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-070)

On the live animals list and on plants' list, a list of more than one page shows pagination with numbered page links, a 'Previous' link from page 2 on and a 'Next' link on every page but the last; a list of one page, or with no results, shows no pagination. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-042; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-071; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-031, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-088, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-092; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-082; ruling:ian-2026-11-25 ruling-ian-2026-11-25-p1-002, ruling-ian-2026-11-25-p1-003)

The live animals list's page links keep the tab (unless it is the default tab), the sort (unless it is the default), the search text and every additional filter. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-035, repo-frontend-p4-074; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-092; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-039, trace-e2e-p2-040; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010)

On the live animals list and on plants' list, on every tab and page, the first card follows the list's controls directly (on the live animals list, the tab's subheading and description), with no line of text between them. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-044; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-037, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-042-m1; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-025; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-013, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-057)

On the live animals list and on plants' list, a search that matches nothing, with no status filter set, shows the list's controls and no cards, with no text under them. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-145; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-041; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-020; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-015, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-082)

On the live animals list and on plants' list, a tab or list holding no notifications shows no cards and no text under the controls; on the live animals list the tab keeps its subheading and description. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-119, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-145; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-042; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-068; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-120; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p9-097; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

rows.notes: Combines page size, numbered pagination, page links that keep the view, and the results-count and empty-list removals, because they change the same list footer, header and paging links on both lists. Page links keep the search and filters because both apply for real (c-163). Plants' list keeps one untabbed list paged at 20 until the plants backend can ask for 8 (c-302, the blocked plants row). Build the numbered pagination in each dashboard feature: the animals frontend's shared paging helper is theme journey-foundation's. The page size the backend serves is its list page size setting. Under c-496's default the germinal products list copy takes the same paging in the same increment once it exists.

rows.title: The lists' success banner is titled 'Success', and plants' deletion banner reads 'Notification has been deleted'
rows.detail: After an action that returns the trader to a list with its flag on the address, such as a delete, the list shows a success banner titled 'Success' with that action's message. Plants' deletion message reads 'Notification has been deleted'. Each list holds this wording in its own copy, so the shared action wording other pages use stays as it is.
acceptanceCriteria: After deleting a notification from the live animals list, the list shows a success notification banner with the role alert, titled 'Success', carrying the delete's message. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-020; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-066; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-099; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-093)

After deleting a notification from plants' list, the list shows a success notification banner with the role alert, titled 'Success', reading 'Notification has been deleted', with a Welsh version of both. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-034, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-069, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-079; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-070, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-101)

Opening either list without an action's flag on its address shows no success banner. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-066; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-067)

sources.ref: features/dashboard template and controller (repo-plantsfrontend-p1-034, p1-069, p1-079)

rows.notes: Combines the 'Success' title on both lists with plants' deletion message, because both change the same banner on plants' list. Takes plants' deletion message out of inc-126: that row keeps the other sets' deletion wording and the amend, cancel and delete walks; this row is the only one of this area's that changes plants' banner. The banner keeps being triggered by the action's flag on the redirect, and is never dismissed by itself or held to show once (c-252). Each list feature holds its own banner wording; the shared notificationActions wording (shared copy and layout, theme journey-foundation's) stays as it is. The Welsh strings are machine drafts that ship only once a translator signs them off.

rows.title: Each set stores the category it creates a draft with
rows.detail: A draft started in the live-animals set is stored with the category live animals, and one started in the germinal products set with the category germinal products, so each notification can reach its own list.
acceptanceCriteria: A draft started from the live-animals set's 'Create new' is stored with the category live animals. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-001)

A draft started in the germinal products set is stored with the category germinal products. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030)
rows.notes: This area's share of inc-176, the germinal set's skeleton, which carries the category on create beside its other requirements: keep it there. The category is read back from the stored record, as the animals backend's list returns it (cards row). A record with no category counts as live animals wherever a list reads it. The backend's record and create path sit in theme overview-and-review's files and the stub create in manage-notifications'; inc-176 already waits on overview-and-review through its externalDependsOn.

rows.title: The germinal products set's root shows its own notification list, a copy of today's live animals list
rows.detail: The germinal products set gets its own notification list at its root in the animals frontend, copying the live animals list as it is now, with wording for germinal products and a start button that starts a germinal products notification. Each animals list shows only its own category's notifications, so a germinal products notification never reaches the live animals list.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in trader opening the germinal products set's root sees the germinal products notification list there, served by the animals frontend at that address. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104)

The germinal products list has the caption 'Dashboard', an h1 and an introduction naming germinal products, a start button, the keyword or reference search, the sort with its 'Update sort' button, the results count, a summary card per notification with its facts, status tag and status-driven actions, Previous and Next paging, the empty-list text and the deletion banner, each as the live animals list has it. (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-021, ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-022; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-003, repo-frontend-p4-005, repo-frontend-p4-013, repo-frontend-p4-029, repo-frontend-p4-037, repo-frontend-p4-039, repo-frontend-p4-051, repo-frontend-p4-066, repo-frontend-p4-068, repo-frontend-p4-071)

Pressing the germinal products list's start button starts a germinal products notification in the germinal products set. (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-022; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-007)

The germinal products list shows only germinal products notifications, and the live animals list shows only live animals notifications, a notification stored with no category among them. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-017; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-112)

sources.ref: the live-animals dashboard feature (repo-frontend-p4-001 to p4-071)

rows.notes: Combines the germinal list copy with the category split of both animals lists, because the copy is only right once the list read filters by category. The 27 November ruling ships the germinal list now as a copy of the live animals list on main, without waiting for the reframe rows (c-495), so this row depends only on inc-176 (the germinal set and the category on create). Under c-496's default every later reframe row changes this copy in the same increment, so the germinal dashboard folder is in those rows' shared code: the combiner should let this folder's theme land before theme animals-dashboard, or put this row in animals-dashboard, rather than keep germinal-products waiting on animals-dashboard. The backend's category filter is the list query (overview-and-review's service file); the reframed germinal list, with its own card facts, is the germinal card row.

rows.title: The germinal products list takes the reframed frame, with its own card facts
rows.detail: Once the live animals list is reframed, the germinal products copy follows it: the h1 'Germinal products', the same search, sort, filters and tabs at its own address, and a card showing the species and product type as its commodity and the number of packages as its quantity.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal products list has the caption 'Dashboard', the h1 'Germinal products', the live animals list's search, sort, additional filters and tabs pointing at its own address, and a 'Create new' button that starts a germinal products notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104)
A germinal products card shows its quantity as 'Quantity (unit/pieces)', the notification's total number of packages across its lines. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)
A germinal products card's commodity is the species, then the product type, separated by a comma, such as 'Cattle, Semen'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)
openQuestions: Whether the reframe rows carry the germinal products list with them (c-496). Default, which the builder follows and says so: yes, each reframe row changes the germinal copy in the same increment, so this row builds whatever of the reframed frame and card facts is left once those rows have landed.
rows.notes: Every requirement here is a question with a default, so none is on the area's to-build list; drafted so the reframed germinal list keeps its row. Its backend facts (packages, species, product type) come from the cards row. Depends on the germinal list row and on every reframe row. Check the cited claims against the germinal requirements before planning: the card fact claims may be re-cited by the combiner.

rows.title: The live animals list's Summary shows 'Action needed' and 'Status updated' glance cards
rows.detail: A 'Summary' section above the notifications holds two glance cards, each with a live count for the category and a link to its own filtered list. It waits until the front door's dashboard requirements firm up.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has an h2 'Summary' with two glance cards: 'Action needed' with 'Tasks requiring your attention' and a 'View tasks' link to the action-needed list for live animals, and 'Status updated' with 'Changes in the past 24 hours' and a 'View updates' link to the changes list for live animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-024, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-123; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-027, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-028, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-029; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-026, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-027; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-075, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-099)

The 'Action needed' card shows the number of live animals notifications that need something from the trader, the same number the list its link opens holds. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-069; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-078; ruling:sam-2026-11-16 ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-018)
openQuestions: Blocked: the front door's dashboard requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October). Who: Sam and the people those requirements are agreed with. Once they exist this summary information is re-distilled, and what the Summary shows, where its counts come from and which pages its links open are decided then.

Blocked as well for the 'Action needed' count: the outstanding-actions banner the dashboard designs under test introduce must be agreed (Sam, 16 November), because nothing action-required is shown until then. Who: Sam and the designers taking those designs through test.
rows.notes: Kept apart from the rows that build now because both requirements wait on a blocker. The 'Status updated' count waits with the authorities' outcomes row.

rows.title: Cards show the authorities' outcomes: delayed and past notifications, their 'View' action and the status-updated count
rows.detail: Once the authorities' case system sends outcomes back to the notification record, a delayed notification shows an error card with its reason, a finished one a green 'Past' tag in the 'Past' tab, each with a single 'View' link, and the 'Status updated' glance card counts the changes of the past 24 hours.
acceptanceCriteria: A delayed notification's card is an error card with a 'Delayed' tag and the reason for the delay as its message. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-052, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-065)

A notification the authorities have finished with shows a green 'Past' tag and is listed in the 'Past' tab. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-118, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-120, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-121; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-059; ruling:sam-2026-11-16 ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-020)

A delayed or finished notification's card offers a single 'View' link, which opens the notification's review page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-126; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-054; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-088; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-093)

The 'Status updated' glance card shows the number of live animals notifications whose status changed in the past 24 hours, the same number the list its link opens holds. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-029; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-078, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-080)
openQuestions: Blocked: the authorities' case system (PIMS Dynamics) must send post-submission outcomes (inspection required, delayed, completed) back to the notification record. Who: the owners of that integration must provide the outcome feed; until they do, no notification reaches these statuses and none of this can be built or observed.
Blocked as well, for the 'Past' status and its style: a real source of completion must exist (Sam, 16 November). Who: the owners of the authorities' outcome feed.

Blocked as well, for the status-updated count: the front door's dashboard requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October). Who: Sam and the people those requirements are agreed with; the count is re-distilled with the summary information.
Whether the finished status reads 'Past' (c-497) and what the 'Past' tab holds (c-498). Default: 'Past', a green tag, holding completed notifications only.
Whether plants' card follows the 'Past' status is decided when this unblocks.
rows.notes: Kept apart because every requirement here waits on the authorities' outcome feed. The single 'View' covers only the statuses the service does not have yet; drafts, submitted and amending cards keep their status-driven actions (c-160). The 'Inspection required' card is out of scope now, so it leaves this row.

rows.title: Plants' list tabs, eight a page, search, sort and filters, once the plants backend can query them
rows.detail: Plants' list takes the live animals list's tabs, page size, search, sort and additional filters once the plants backend, outside this programme, can query plants notifications by status, keyword and arrival date, with the new sorts and a page size of 8.
acceptanceCriteria: Plants' list has the live animals list's tabs, with the same counts, subheadings, descriptions and grouping by status. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-011, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-025, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-029, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-032; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-072, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-073)

Plants' list shows 8 notifications a page. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-031, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-056; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-072, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-073)

Plants' list has one 'Search by' GET form with its hint and icon-only search button, a keyword search over the reference, commodity and consignor, the sorts 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date' applied by that form, the 'Additional filters', and page links that keep them. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-011; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-039, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-074, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-097)

sources.ref: features/dashboard (repo-plantsfrontend-p1-011, p1-025, p1-029, p1-031, p1-032, p1-056)

openQuestions: Blocked: the plants backend (trade-imports-plants-backend), outside this programme, must let plants' list query plants notifications by status for the tabs and their counts, ask for a page size of 8, and search by keyword, status and arrival date with the new sorts (the plants read model in deferred.md). Who: that backend's owners. Until then plants' list keeps today's search, sort and paging.
Which words the tabs use (c-497). Default: the live animals list's tabs as built.
